She seems very sensible.

sensible advice

It’s sensible to keep a note of your passport number.

Moving house seemed like the sensible thing to do .

She needed to confess her sins and ask for forgiveness.

He knew that he had committed a terrible sin .

The best solution would be for them to separate.

a period of relative stability

Our friendship has steadily strengthened over the years.

Steve’s opposition only strengthened her resolve to go ahead.

The company plans to strengthen its hand (= make itself more powerful ) in Europe by opening an office in Spain.

challenges to the existing power structure

A new management structure has been introduced.

molecular structures

...one of the country's biggest food suppliers.

Freudian theory has had a great influence on psychology.

After five days of heavy rain the Telle river was a raging torrent (= a very violent torrent ) .

It was a tough race.

She’s had a tough life.

The company admitted that it had been a tough year.

Tough decisions will have to be made.

The reporters were asking a lot of tough questions .

(= a difficult decision ) , but we had to cancel the game because of the weather.

I find his books pretty tough going (= difficult to read ) .

Gage predicted the president’s proposal would be a tough sell (= something that is difficult to persuade someone about ) before Congress.

twitter

Doreen appeared to be unconscious of the amusement she had caused.

The jacket is available in various colours.

There are various ways to answer your question.

He decided to leave school for various reasons.

The work she does is absolutely vital.

It is vital to be honest with your children.

The tourist industry is of vital importance to the national economy.

Richardson played a vital role in the team’s success.

The samples could give scientists vital information about long-term changes in the earth’s atmosphere.

It took all his willpower to remain calm.

An alternative route is along the Via Unione.

Alfred was intensely ambitious, obsessed with the idea of becoming rich.

In fact, she was an archaeologist.

But I do not believe, as a field archaeologist, that we can use the scientific method to prove or disprove [them].
